item.title: Mercer Lab Exhibit - WESTVIEW NEWS
item.description: By Brinadee Bratcher February marked the opening of Mercer Labs, an expansive 36,000 square foot, immersive, art exhibit created by Roy Nachum. Nachum is an Israeli native whose celebrity collaborators include performers such as Kanye West, Arianna Grande, and Rihanna. It should come as no surprise that the opening of this exhibit was highly anticipated.
